headline: Habits are automatic behaviors—actions you repeat without conscious decision
universal_truth: You become what you repeatedly do; habits are the compound interest of behavior
fun_facts: About 40% of daily actions are habits, not conscious decisions
Habits form when behaviors move from the prefrontal cortex to the basal ganglia
It takes an average of 66 days to form a new habit, though this varies widely
discussion_questions: What habits run your life without your conscious input?
Which habits serve you and which harm you?
What habit, if formed, would most improve your life?

hook.script: You don't decide to brush your teeth each morning—you just do it. Habits are behaviors so repeated they've become automatic. Nearly half your daily actions run on autopilot. Your habits are running your life.

cliff.script: Habits can seem small, but they compound over time. Why are these automatic behaviors so powerful?
cliff.prompt: Why do habits matter so much?

options.text: Habits compound—small repeated actions accumulate into large effects; you become what you repeatedly do without deciding
options.response: Yes. One cookie doesn't matter. A daily cookie habit adds pounds. One workout doesn't matter. A daily workout habit transforms bodies. Habits are behavior's compound interest.
They do save energy, but more importantly, they shape who you become over time...

fact1.title: Automatic Accumulation
fact1.script: Habits remove decision from repetition. This is powerful for good or bad. Good habits build you automatically. Bad habits destroy you automatically. The autopilot flies toward whatever you've programmed.

fact2.title: Cue-Routine-Reward
fact2.script: Habits follow a loop: cue triggers routine which delivers reward. Understanding this loop lets you design new habits and disrupt old ones. Find the cue, change the routine.

fact3.title: Habit Audit
fact3.script: What's running on autopilot in your life? Some habits serve your goals; others undermine them. You chose these once, even if you don't remember. Choose again if needed.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: You become what you repeatedly do. Habits are the compound interest of behavior. Program your autopilot wisely.

outro.script: That's Day 284. Tomorrow, we'll explore getting better on purpose—deliberate practice. Until then, notice what you do without thinking.

growTrack.title: Habit Audit - What's Running on Autopilot?
growTrack.learning_objective: Identify automatic behaviors and evaluate their effects
growTrack.activity: List your daily habits—morning routine, eating patterns, work behaviors, evening activities. Which serve your goals? Which undermine them? Pick one to build or break this month.
